program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_c@i & is_bos@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j & !is_c@j | !is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_c@i, !is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_c@i)
h1_2 = leftmost(!is_b@i & !is_b@j | is_bos@i & is_a@i & is_bos@j & is_a@j & is_b@j & is_c@j, !is_b@i)
accept = !is_bos & !is_b & !h1_1 | !h1_1 & h1_2

output accept
